description: The chart illustrates the ratio of three categories - Movies, Songs, and Basketball - across three different models: Llama3, represented in blue, an unnamed model in red, and ChatGPT, represented in yellow. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled "Ratio (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, marked at intervals of 10. For each category, a group of three bars is displayed, with the blue bar representing Llama3, the red bar representing the unnamed model, and the yellow bar representing ChatGPT. The values for Llama3 are approximately 90% for Movies, 83% for Songs, and 67% for Basketball; the red bars are at around 90% for Movies, 90% for Songs, and 57% for Basketball; and the yellow bars are at approximately 72% for Movies, 61% for Songs, and 61% for Basketball. The bars are grouped by category, with the three models represented side by side for each category, and are not sorted in any particular order. No bars are visually emphasized.
